name: Log daily department attendance to Lark Base with Lark

parameters.content:
# Log daily department attendance to Lark Base with Lark

# How it works
# This template runs either on **Daily Schedule** or on **Manual Trigger** for testing. **Template Config** is the only setup node most users need to touch. The workflow gets a Lark tenant access token, loads all users in the configured department, calculates today's time window in the selected timezone, fetches each user's attendance records, keeps the first check-in and last check-out, then writes batched rows into Lark Base.

# Setup
# Fill in the 5 required values in **Template Config**: `app_id`, `app_secret`, `department_id`, `bitable_AppToken`, and `bitable_TableId`. Then make sure your Lark Base table already contains the required English columns listed in **05 - Required Lark Base fields**.

# Customization
# Optional settings in **Template Config** let you change timezone, page size, batch size, and late/checkout thresholds. Manual tests create real rows, so test against a copy table first if needed.

# Step 1 - Trigger and setup

# Use **Daily Schedule** for automatic runs. Most users only need to update the placeholders in **Template Config**.

# Step 2 - Get token and department users

# Requests a Lark tenant access token, then fetches users from the configured department using the shared page-size setting from **Template Config**.

# Step 3 - Query attendance and shape records

# Uses the shared timezone and attendance thresholds from **Template Config**, then prepares batched Lark Base records from the first check-in and last check-out.

# Step 4 - Write to Lark Base

# Sends the prepared batches to the configured Lark Base app and table. The target table must already include the required columns from **05 - Required Lark Base fields**.

# Required Lark Base fields

# Create these columns in your target table before using this template:

| Field name | Suggested type |
| --- | --- |
| Employee | User |
| Check In Time | DateTime |
| Check Out Time | DateTime |
| Check In Comment | Text |
| Check Out Comment | Text |
| Check In Location | Text |
| Employee Code | Text |
| Check In Status | Single select |
| Check Out Status | Single select |

Suggested select values:
- Check In Status: `On-time`, `Late`, `Very Late (0.5 Day Leave)`
- Check Out Status: `Early Out`
